company.name: xflow
company.shortDescription: SD: Xflow builds cross-border payments infrastructure enabling businesses to send and receive international payments.
company.description: Xflow develops crossborder payments infrastructure that enables businesses to send and receive international payments across multiple currencies and countries. The platform provides tools for payment collection, foreign exchange conversion, and settlement for global transactions. It supports integration for businesses and platforms to embed international payment workflows into their systems. Xflow focuses on simplifying compliance and transaction processing for cross-border financial operations.
